answer: Sybil defense here is a bond locked per identity. An agent stakes protocol tokens before earning rewards, and the stake binds to one identity, not a wallet. A farm posts one bond per puppet at once: ten thousand fakes pay ten thousand stakes upfront, like paying for every passenger on a voyage before sailing. Detection slashes the bond and freezes it in cooldown. An honest agent needs one refundable bond, an oasis of cheap entry, while a farmer keeps every copycat bond locked at once. A newcomer on the tundra is unblocked, since the bond scales with reward. Honest stakes return; fakes vanish.
